I have the orders and the refunds confirmed to match. Now I need to calculate the net balance for each customer: acme, birch, and cobalt. I will call net_balance(customer) for each unique customer found in the orders: acme, birch, and cobalt.
Next, I need to get the net balance for 'birch'.
Finally, I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (33841 cents), birch (35184 cents), and cobalt (18779 cents). Since the refunds matched, I can now proceed to record a payout for each customer. I will record the payouts sequentially.
